extension.summary: Zidoo playback with automatic Kodi resume updates
extension.description: Use Kodi for Zidoo Helper 0.2.12 for SMB filenames containing #. Keep Experimental ZDMC launch OFF. Includes return process and window diagnostics. Optional experimental SMB library playback requires saved Zidoo NAS credentials. Plays library movies, TV episodes and music videos in the Zidoo native player. Verifies final resume points and automatically marks watched at a final position of 90 percent. Preview release tested on Z30 Pro; Kodi 22 may restart during native playback.
